sprint.description: The sprint to build: its number in ephemeral/research/api/SPRINTS.md, e.g. 2. Give this or an issue.

issue.description: The issue to build instead of a sprint: a GitHub issue number, or the path of a file holding the issue's text.

work_dir.description: Absolute path of the working directory. Each validated task is committed to the branch checked out there, and the sprint ends by merging that branch.

tasks.description: The most tasks to run in all; absent means 10. The sprint fails if the planner is not done by then.
